dataset: NHANES 2009-2018 pooled (F+G+H+I+J) - MCQ230A-D, code 16 (colon) / 31 (rectum), age>=40 (app gate). Only 4 of the 9 app features exist in NHANES; 19,201 rows / 215 cases (1.1%) -> LOW_FEATURE_MODEL + HEAVY_IMBALANCE. S18 pooled H+I+J (11,463 rows / 120 cases); this pass added the 2009-2012 cycles F/G. The earlier single-cycle test AUC 0.694 was small-sample luck; judge the pooled score as the honest estimate.
known_limitations: App-aligned projection of a real public dataset (ml/data/README.md) — not a local clinical sample; revalidate on local data before clinical use

Columns the source dataset never collected: family_cancer, diet_quality, blood_in_stool, bowel_change, colorectal_weight_loss — the app still asks these but the model cannot use them (LOW_FEATURE_MODEL)
Screening and awareness tool only, not a diagnostic device
